metadata.description: Nibble: small, safe bites of change for repos you do not know. Two loops that share map and commit: fix (scan, trace, fix) and build (plan, build, cover).

plugins.name: nibble
plugins.description: Land in an unfamiliar repo and change it safely, one small bite at a time. Fix a bug: map, scan, trace, fix, commit. Or build a feature: map, plan, build, cover, commit. Language and agent agnostic, with first-class Android/Java/Kotlin support.
